plan: plan T10/T19: media-hub serves openvibe.download as a private drive in v1; openvibe.video serves public read-only watch pages and playlists for OpenVibe.Live recordings and clips (Video v1 step C); openvibe.pics is parked (302 to openvibe.network) until scanning and abuse intake exist
domain: openvibe.download and openvibe.video (openvibe.pics is parked: it redirects to openvibe.network)
summary: OpenVibe.MediaHub: openvibe.download as a private drive. Account-only uploads stream into OpenVibe.Media (a plain form up to 256 MB, resumable parts beyond). Files are private. Share links expire in 1 hour to 7 days, need a signed-in downloader and can be limited to named accounts (matched by subject). Reports suspend a share for staff. Downloads are always sandboxed attachments. Per-person quotas, and account export and deletion (ADR-033). openvibe.video serves public watch pages and playlists for Live's recordings and clips (no uploads); openvibe.pics is parked and redirects to openvibe.network.
works: Sign-in with OpenVibe.Network (PKCE S256, httpOnly session cookies); pages server-rendered, complete without JavaScript
Uploads: a plain form streamed to disk with its sha256 (up to 256 MB), and resumable chunked uploads (8 MB parts) through Media multipart
Private files and folders, per-person limits (2 GB stored, 512 MB per file, 50 uploads a day, 20 live shares)
Share links: 1 hour to 7 days, revocable, counted, sign-in required, optional named accounts (Network subjects only)
Reports: 3 distinct people or one report of illegal content suspend a share; staff restore or remove (Media object deleted)
Downloads: attachment, nosniff, sandbox CSP, real type only for a safe list, filename* for any script, Range resume
OpenVibe.Video step A: public watch pages on openvibe.video (/v/:id, /c/:id, /@:username) reading Live's public API, with WebVTT captions/chapters and no uploads

OpenVibe.Video playlists: a signed-in person's named lists of Live recordings and clips (/playlists, /playlists/:id), with a browser-session and app API (video.playlist.read / video.playlist.manage), the ?list= watch flow, and sign-in on the video host
Parked domain: openvibe.pics redirects to openvibe.network in nginx; no request reaches the app
Account export and deletion (ADR-033) through openvibe-sdk/account-data; subscriptions created at boot
Per-caller and per-address limits; readiness (database required); metrics on loopback
notYet: Signed-out uploads on openvibe.pics (MEDIAHUB_PICS_ANONYMOUS) and openvibe.download (MEDIAHUB_DOWNLOAD_ANONYMOUS): built and off until the owner registers the DMCA designated agent and the CSAM hash-matching account (plan T10)
Scanning of uploads (hash lists, malware) and abuse intake shared with OpenVibe.Media's holds
App, agent and service tokens on the drive, Pics and video upload routes: only the two playlist capabilities are registered; every other /api/v1 route needs a signed-in person
deployment: openvibe-ovh: unit openvibe-media-hub.service on 127.0.0.1:4990 (git checkout /opt/openvibe.download, env /etc/openvibe/media-hub.env, database ov_media_hub), deployed with `sudo ovhost deploy media-hub`; public at https://openvibe.download since 2026-10-08, https://openvibe.video since 2026-10-12 and https://openvibe.pics since 2026-10-15.
